title: The affine fppf site is a dense subsite of the big fppf site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $\mathcal C=(\mathit{Aff}/S)_{fppf}$ be the site of affine $S$-schemes with fppf coverings and let $\mathcal D=(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ be the big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. The inclusion $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ is dense: every object of $\mathcal D$ has an fppf covering by objects of $\mathcal C$, and every fppf covering of an affine object admits a refinement by a covering in $\mathcal C$. Consequently restriction along $u$ induces an equivalence between sheaves of sets on $\mathcal D$ and sheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$ (and likewise for abelian sheaves), with quasi-inverse given by sheaf transport along the dense inclusion.
